description: This file defines application state management functions and configuration for the Excalidraw drawing app, including default state, state filtering for storage/export, and utility functions for tool detection.

methods.name: getDefaultAppState
methods.description: Returns the default application state object with preset values.

methods.name: _clearAppStateForStorage
methods.description: Filters app state properties based on storage type configuration.

methods.name: clearAppStateForLocalStorage
methods.description: Prepares app state for local storage by filtering properties.

methods.name: cleanAppStateForExport
methods.description: Prepares app state for export by filtering properties.

methods.name: clearAppStateForDatabase
methods.description: Prepares app state for database storage by filtering properties.

methods.name: isEraserActive
methods.description: Checks if the current active tool is an eraser.

methods.name: isHandToolActive
methods.description: Checks if the current active tool is a hand tool.
